I should return to the seams while the leather still has some give.
A few cuts need reinforcing before the client comes back.
I have wax to work in and buckles to test.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to smoothing grain and trimming edges.
I promised a set of straps by this afternoon, and they are not done yet.
The thread is still coiled, waiting for my hand.
I need to check my tools. Somehow they have wandered again.
No glove stitches itself, and I have one waiting.
Time to get back to the workshop and finish these pieces properly.
